sloka: अष्टका पितृदैवत्यमित्ययं प्रसृतो जन: ।अन्नस्योपद्रवं पश्य मृतो हि किमशिष्यति ॥ २.१०८.१४॥
transliteration: aṣṭakā pitṛdaivatyamityayaṁ prasṛto jana: ।annasyopadravaṁ paśya mṛto hi kimaśiṣyati ॥ 2.108.14॥

translations.english: People perform ashtaka ceremony for the spirits of ancestors and offer them food. Look at the amount of food being wasted. Will the dead (ever) eat food?
